items.rejected_claim: Every heavy color class occupies a single face.
items.verification: independent maximal-run solver and certificate enumeration
items.minimality: Requires at least four heavy positions and two rigid positions; witness attains six.
items.correction: Certificate blocks are confined, not color classes.

items.rejected_claim: Any subset of one geometric face preserves joins of actual certificate partitions.
items.verification: global union-find connected; internal BFS disconnected
items.minimality: First possible distinct noncrossing pair/triple certificate partitions occur at length four.
items.correction: Use the full face carrier or separately prove path locality.

items.rejected_claim: Rigid noncrossing plus winning heavy-face words implies global winning without excluding singleton colors.
items.correction: Require all color classes to have size at least two.

items.rejected_claim: Restriction preserves all binary equivalence joins.
items.correction: Locality is necessary; geometric edge saturation is sufficient.

items.rejected_claim: The product of certificate counts is the count of winning color patterns.
items.correction: Separate partition-level bijections from color-pattern enumeration.

items.rejected_claim: The baseline definition of FacePathLocality is strictly stronger than binary restriction/join equality.
items.verification: Path soundness and completeness give both implications.
items.correction: The definition is equivalent; edge saturation is a stronger, geometric sufficient condition.
items.formal_status: equivalence explanation only; not added as a Lean theorem

limitations: Finite witnesses are computationally verified; no separate Lean finite-counterexample theorem added.
